name: memory
description: Persistent memory across sessions. The initial prompt contains a complete immutable body-free index for the acting principal, with the active project ID when present; later turns may contain live metadata pointers. Actions: 'save' stores a memory and always requires a one-line description (max 512 chars), 'get' retrieves live full content by name, 'search' finds body-free metadata by query, 'list' shows body-free metadata, 'delete' removes a memory. Only 'get' records an access. A successful save may append informational index-health prose; its over-budget notice is opt-in and off by default. Scopes: 'global', 'workstream', 'user', 'coordinator', 'project' - defined on the scope parameter, including project-attachment pinning and fail-closed access rules. Pass the displayed scope explicitly when following a search/list result from another scope.

name.description: Memory identifier (required for 'save', 'get', and 'delete'). Use a lowercase ASCII snake_case semantic key. Do not use punctuation or non-Latin scripts; keep native-language wording in the required description or content.

description.description: Required authored one-line index hook on every 'save' (create or update). Whitespace is normalized and the result must contain 1-512 characters.

scope.description: Memory scope. 'global' = shared across everything; 'workstream' = private to this workstream; 'user' = follows the acting user across workstreams; 'coordinator' = the acting user's private orchestration namespace, durable across their coordinator sessions; 'project' = the shared bucket of the project attached to this session. Any stored project attachment pins unscoped save/get/delete to project; missing, archived, revoked, or mutation-denied access fails closed without fallback; read-only access still permits get; authorized reactivation restores eligibility. No attachment uses the session-kind default. Search/list without scope use all visible scopes; a valid explicit scope selects exactly that scope.

coordinator.description: Persistent orchestration memory for the acting user. The initial prompt contains a complete immutable body-free index, with the active project ID when present; later turns may contain live metadata pointers. Actions: 'save' requires a one-line description (max 512 chars), 'get' retrieves live full content by name, 'search'/'list' return body-free metadata, 'delete' removes a memory. Only 'get' records an access. A successful save may append informational index-health prose; its over-budget notice is opt-in and off by default. Coordinator memories survive across that user's coordinator sessions and are NOT visible to child workstreams; only no project attachment defaults to coordinator. Project-attachment pinning and fail-closed access rules are documented on the `scope` parameter.
